SELECT "created_day" AS "created_day",
       concat_ws(' / ', ("client_name")::text, ("priority_ticket")::text) AS "client_name / priority_ticket",
       COUNT(DISTINCT "id_ticket") AS "COUNT_DISTINCT(id_ticket)"
  FROM (
SELECT 
  id_ticket, 
  max(client_name) as client_name, 
  max(label_category) as label_category,
  max(priority_ticket) as priority_ticket,
  MIN(created_at) AS created_day,
  max(ticket_title) as title,
  CASE WHEN max(github_link) IN ('', NULL) THEN 'SemIssue' ELSE max(github_link) END as github_link,
  max(last_comment_at) as last_comment_at,
  string_agg(email || ': ' || last_comment, '') as last_comment,
  (SELECT completed_at 
     FROM cs_operations_help360 
     WHERE id_ticket = t.id_ticket 
     ORDER BY created_at DESC, completed_at DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS completed_day,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT completed_at 
              FROM cs_operations_help360 
              WHERE id_ticket = t.id_ticket 
              ORDER BY created_at DESC, completed_at DESC 
              LIMIT 1) IS NULL 
        THEN TRUE 
        ELSE FALSE 
    END AS is_open,
  min(CASE WHEN (t.task_duration_min != 0 and count_to_sla is TRUE) THEN t.task_duration_min END) as firstAutoSlatask_dur_min,
  MAX(hours_dev) AS estimated_hours_dev, 
  MAX(hours_cs) AS estimated_hours_cs,
  max(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is TRUE THEN first_touch_duration_min END) as first_touch_dur_min,
  max(ticket_duration_days) AS continuous_days_spent,
  max(business_hours_spent)/24 AS business_days_spent,
  count(id_task) as task_count,
  count(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is true THEN id_task ELSE null END) as SLA_task_count,
  AVG(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is true and aging_task_min is null THEN task_duration_min ELSE null END) AS SLA_avg_task_duration_min,
  SUM(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is true and aging_task_min is null THEN task_duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS SLA_total_task_duration_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is true and aging_task_min is null THEN task_duration_min ELSE null END) AS SLA_max_task_duration_min,
  MIN(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is true and aging_task_min is null THEN task_duration_min ELSE null END) AS SLA_min_task_duration_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN count_to_sla is false and aging_task_min is null THEN task_duration_min ELSE null END) AS not_SLA_max_task_duration_min
FROM 
  public.cs_operations_help360 t
GROUP by 
  id_ticket
  ORDER BY id_ticket ASC
) AS src
 WHERE "is_open" = TRUE
   {{ filters }}
 GROUP BY "created_day", concat_ws(' / ', ("client_name")::text, ("priority_ticket")::text)
 ORDER BY 1 ASC

     LEFT JOIN (

        WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as chamado_em_analise

    LEFT JOIN (

    LEFT JOIN (
SELECT id_ticket,

        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE id_task_definition in ('494','496')  
        group by id_ticket
        having sum(task_duration_min) > 1
    ) as n2_info
    ON n2_info.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY PARA O TEMPO DE PRIMEIRO RETORNO (IGNORANDO RECALCULAR SLA)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_base.id_ticket,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                    LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) 
                    - 
                    GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
                )) / 3600.0
            ) AS tempo_de_primeiro_retorno
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                inicio.id_ticket,
                inicio.start_ts,
                fim.end_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS start_ts
                FROM cs_operations_help360
                WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) inicio
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(completed_at) AS end_ts
                FROM (
                    SELECT 
                        id_ticket, 
                        name_task, 
                        completed_at,
                        LEAD(name_task) OVER (PARTITION BY id_ticket ORDER BY created_at) as next_task
                    FROM cs_operations_help360
                ) sequencia
                WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
                  AND (next_task NOT IN ('Transformar em Chamado de Suporte', 'Transformar em Chamado de Bug ', 'Executar - Preencher SLA') OR next_task IS NULL)
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) fim ON inicio.id_ticket = fim.id_ticket
        ) t_base
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(t_base.start_ts::date, t_base.end_ts::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
        WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.day) < 6
          AND t_base.start_ts IS NOT NULL 
          AND t_base.end_ts IS NOT NULL
          AND LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) > GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
        GROUP BY t_base.id_ticket
    ) as primeiro_retorno
    ON primeiro_retorno.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: TEMPO PARA N3 UTILIZANDO A LÓGICA DO V360 (task_duration_min / 60)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_tasks.id_ticket,
            SUM(t_tasks.task_duration_min) / 60.0 AS tempo_para_n3
        FROM cs_operations_help360 t_tasks
        INNER JOIN (
            -- Descobre quando o chamado entrou na fila de N3 pela primeira vez
            SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS n3_start_ts
            FROM cs_operations_help360
            WHERE name_task IN ('Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração', 'Aguardando Desenvolvimento de Integração')
            GROUP BY id_ticket
        ) n3_entry ON t_tasks.id_ticket = n3_entry.id_ticket
        -- Soma o tempo (onde tem SLA) de todas as tarefas ANTERIORES à entrada em N3
        WHERE t_tasks.count_to_sla = true 
          AND t_tasks.created_at < n3_entry.n3_start_ts
        GROUP BY t_tasks.id_ticket
    ) as n3_time
    ON n3_time.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
    WHERE 
        t.id_ticket NOT IN (SELECT id_ticket FROM cs_operations_help360 WHERE completed_at IS NULL)  and  t.process_completion_type <> 'CANCELED' and t.client_name <> 'v360-interno' 
    GROUP BY 
        t.id_ticket,
        t.payed_by_customer,
        reclassificacao.teve_transformar, 
        n2_info.atuacao_n2,
        n2_info.tempo_atuacao_n2,
        primeiro_retorno.tempo_de_primeiro_retorno,
        n3_time.tempo_para_n3, 
        first_answer.tempo_de_resposta_inicial,
        tempo_v360.hours_v360,
        dev_integracao.tempo_de_integracao,
        chamado_em_analise.tempo_de_analise,
        concluido_inativo.fechado_por_inatividade,
        chamado_recusado.ticket_refused,
        info_complementares.complementary_info,

        parceiro_integracao_b.parceiro_integracao,
        t.contracted_plan,
        t.cf_atendente_dev,
        t.cf_atendente_suporte,
        t.fluxo,
        t.cf_categoria_novo,
        t.cf_area_problema,
        t.cf_ajuda_funcional_dev,
        t.cf_funcional_ou_dev_que_ajudou,
        t.cf_complexidade_da_ajuda,
        t.cf_erp_cliente,
        t.cf_classificacao_chamados
      
) g

                    - 
                    GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
                )) / 3600.0
            ) AS tempo_de_primeiro_retorno
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                inicio.id_ticket,
                inicio.start_ts,
                fim.end_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS start_ts
                FROM cs_operations_help360

            LEFT JOIN (

                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) fim ON inicio.id_ticket = fim.id_ticket
        ) t_base
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(t_base.start_ts::date, t_base.end_ts::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
        WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.day) < 6
          AND t_base.start_ts IS NOT NULL 
          AND t_base.end_ts IS NOT NULL
          AND LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) > GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
        GROUP BY t_base.id_ticket
    ) as primeiro_retorno
    ON primeiro_retorno.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

        -- Soma o tempo (onde tem SLA) de todas as tarefas ANTERIORES à entrada em N3
        WHERE t_tasks.count_to_sla = true 
          AND t_tasks.created_at < n3_entry.n3_start_ts
        GROUP BY t_tasks.id_ticket
    ) as n3_time
    ON n3_time.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

        MAX(hours_dev) AS hours_dev, 
        MAX(hours_cs) AS hours_cs,

        max(responsible_attendant) as responsible_attendant,
        SUM(CASE WHEN count_to_sla IS TRUE AND aging_task_min IS NULL THEN task_duration_min ELSE 0 END) AS SLA_dur_ticket,
        max(primeiro_comentario),
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (min(primeiro_comentario::timestamp) - min(created_at_ticket)))/3600 as first_at_ticket,
        
        CASE 
            WHEN reclassificacao.teve_transformar IS NULL THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS chamados_nao_reclassificados,
        
        n2_info.atuacao_n2,
        n2_info.tempo_atuacao_n2,
        
        primeiro_retorno.tempo_de_primeiro_retorno,
        n3_time.tempo_para_n3, 
        max(suport_sla) as suport_sla,
        max(low_prio_sla) as low_prio_sla,
        max(medium_prio_sla) as medium_prio_sla,
        max(high_prio_sla) as high_prio_sla,

        max(category_ticket) as category_ticket,
        max(csat_motivo) as csat_motivo,

        first_answer.tempo_de_resposta_inicial,
        tempo_v360.hours_v360,
        dev_integracao.tempo_de_integracao,
        chamado_em_analise.tempo_de_analise,
        concluido_inativo.fechado_por_inatividade,
        chamado_recusado.ticket_refused,

        bug_to_suporte.bug_to_suport,
        parceiro_integracao_b.parceiro_integracao,
        t.contracted_plan,
        t.cf_atendente_dev,
        t.cf_atendente_suporte,
        t.fluxo,
        bool_or(chamado_pos_tombamento) as chamado_pos_tombamento,
        t.cf_categoria_novo,
        t. cf_area_problema,
        t.cf_ajuda_funcional_dev,
        t. cf_funcional_ou_dev_que_ajudou,
        t.cf_complexidade_da_ajuda,
        t.cf_erp_cliente,
        t.cf_classificacao_chamados

    FROM 
        public.cs_operations_help360 t
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            id_ticket as id_ticket_final,
            max(created_at) as final_completed_at
        FROM
            cs_operations_help360 c	
        WHERE final_task
        GROUP BY
            id_ticket
            
    ) as final_task 
    ON final_task.id_ticket_final = t.id_ticket
    
    
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS Tempo_de_Resposta_Inicial
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as first_answer
    ON first_answer.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS Tempo_de_integracao
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as dev_integracao
    ON dev_integracao.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS tempo_de_analise
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as chamado_em_analise
    ON chamado_em_analise.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
    
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min)/60 AS hours_v360
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE count_to_sla = true 
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as tempo_v360
    ON tempo_v360.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
                  when count_to_sla = FALSE then TRUE
                  else FALSE
                   end AS fechado_por_inatividade
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Executar - Comentar na nota encerrando o chamado'
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        fechado_por_inatividade
    ) as concluido_inativo
    ON concluido_inativo.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
                  when count_to_sla = FALSE then TRUE
                  else FALSE
                   end AS ticket_refused
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Recusado'
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        ticket_refused
    ) as chamado_recusado
    ON chamado_recusado.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
                  when count_to_sla = FALSE then TRUE
                  else FALSE
                   end AS bug_to_suport
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Transformar em Chamado de Suporte' 
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        bug_to_suport
    ) as bug_to_suporte
    ON bug_to_suporte.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
               when count_to_sla = FALSE then true
               else false end as complementary_info
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Informações Complementares - PRD' 
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        complementary_info
    ) as info_complementares
    ON info_complementares.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               count_to_sla as parceiro_integracao
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração - Parceiro de Integração' 
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        parceiro_integracao
    ) as parceiro_integracao_b
    ON parceiro_integracao_b.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: IDENTIFICA SE O CHAMADO PASSOU POR ALGUMA TAREFA DE TRANSFORMAR
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               true AS teve_transformar
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task ILIKE '%transformar%'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as reclassificacao
    ON reclassificacao.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- NOVA SUBQUERY: INFO DE ATUAÇÃO N2 (TAREFA 534)
    LEFT JOIN (
SELECT id_ticket,
               true AS atuacao_n2,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS tempo_atuacao_n2
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE id_task_definition in ('494','496')  
        group by id_ticket
        having sum(task_duration_min) > 1
    ) as n2_info
    ON n2_info.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY PARA O TEMPO DE PRIMEIRO RETORNO (IGNORANDO RECALCULAR SLA)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_base.id_ticket,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                    LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) 
                    - 
                    GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
                )) / 3600.0
            ) AS tempo_de_primeiro_retorno
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                inicio.id_ticket,
                inicio.start_ts,
                fim.end_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS start_ts
                FROM cs_operations_help360
                WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) inicio
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(completed_at) AS end_ts
                FROM (
                    SELECT 
                        id_ticket, 
                        name_task, 
                        completed_at,
                        LEAD(name_task) OVER (PARTITION BY id_ticket ORDER BY created_at) as next_task
                    FROM cs_operations_help360
                ) sequencia
                WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
                  AND (next_task NOT IN ('Transformar em Chamado de Suporte', 'Transformar em Chamado de Bug ', 'Executar - Preencher SLA') OR next_task IS NULL)
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) fim ON inicio.id_ticket = fim.id_ticket
        ) t_base
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(t_base.start_ts::date, t_base.end_ts::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
        WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.day) < 6
          AND t_base.start_ts IS NOT NULL 
          AND t_base.end_ts IS NOT NULL
          AND LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) > GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
        GROUP BY t_base.id_ticket
    ) as primeiro_retorno
    ON primeiro_retorno.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: TEMPO PARA N3 UTILIZANDO A LÓGICA DO V360 (task_duration_min / 60)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_tasks.id_ticket,
            SUM(t_tasks.task_duration_min) / 60.0 AS tempo_para_n3
        FROM cs_operations_help360 t_tasks
        INNER JOIN (
            -- Descobre quando o chamado entrou na fila de N3 pela primeira vez
            SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS n3_start_ts
            FROM cs_operations_help360
            WHERE name_task IN ('Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração', 'Aguardando Desenvolvimento de Integração')
            GROUP BY id_ticket
        ) n3_entry ON t_tasks.id_ticket = n3_entry.id_ticket
        -- Soma o tempo (onde tem SLA) de todas as tarefas ANTERIORES à entrada em N3
        WHERE t_tasks.count_to_sla = true 
          AND t_tasks.created_at < n3_entry.n3_start_ts
        GROUP BY t_tasks.id_ticket
    ) as n3_time
    ON n3_time.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
    WHERE 
        t.id_ticket NOT IN (SELECT id_ticket FROM cs_operations_help360 WHERE completed_at IS NULL)  and  t.process_completion_type <> 'CANCELED' and t.client_name <> 'v360-interno' 
    GROUP BY 
        t.id_ticket,
        t.payed_by_customer,
        reclassificacao.teve_transformar, 
        n2_info.atuacao_n2,
        n2_info.tempo_atuacao_n2,
        primeiro_retorno.tempo_de_primeiro_retorno,
        n3_time.tempo_para_n3, 
        first_answer.tempo_de_resposta_inicial,

        chamado_em_analise.tempo_de_analise,
        concluido_inativo.fechado_por_inatividade,

        info_complementares.complementary_info,

        t.cf_area_problema,

        t.cf_funcional_ou_dev_que_ajudou,
        t.cf_complexidade_da_ajuda,
        t.cf_erp_cliente,
        t.cf_classificacao_chamados
      
) g

GROUP BY

    client_name,
    resposta_csat,

    first_at_ticket,

        t.cf_classificacao_chamados

            cs_operations_help360 c	
        WHERE final_task
        GROUP BY
            id_ticket
            
    ) as final_task

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS Tempo_de_Resposta_Inicial
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as first_answer
    ON first_answer.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS Tempo_de_integracao
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as dev_integracao
    ON dev_integracao.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS tempo_de_analise
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as chamado_em_analise
    ON chamado_em_analise.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
    
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               SUM(task_duration_min)/60 AS hours_v360
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE count_to_sla = true 
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as tempo_v360

     LEFT JOIN (

        GROUP BY id_ticket,

    ) as parceiro_integracao_b
    ON parceiro_integracao_b.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: IDENTIFICA SE O CHAMADO PASSOU POR ALGUMA TAREFA DE TRANSFORMAR
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,

        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task ILIKE '%transformar%'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as reclassificacao
    ON reclassificacao.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- NOVA SUBQUERY: INFO DE ATUAÇÃO N2 (TAREFA 534)
    LEFT JOIN (
SELECT id_ticket,
               true AS atuacao_n2,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS tempo_atuacao_n2
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE id_task_definition in ('494','496')  
        group by id_ticket
        having sum(task_duration_min) > 1
    ) as n2_info
    ON n2_info.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY PARA O TEMPO DE PRIMEIRO RETORNO (IGNORANDO RECALCULAR SLA)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_base.id_ticket,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                    LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) 
                    - 
                    GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
                )) / 3600.0
            ) AS tempo_de_primeiro_retorno
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                inicio.id_ticket,
                inicio.start_ts,
                fim.end_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS start_ts
                FROM cs_operations_help360
                WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) inicio
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(completed_at) AS end_ts
                FROM (
                    SELECT 
                        id_ticket, 
                        name_task, 
                        completed_at,
                        LEAD(name_task) OVER (PARTITION BY id_ticket ORDER BY created_at) as next_task
                    FROM cs_operations_help360
                ) sequencia
                WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
                  AND (next_task NOT IN ('Transformar em Chamado de Suporte', 'Transformar em Chamado de Bug ', 'Executar - Preencher SLA') OR next_task IS NULL)
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) fim ON inicio.id_ticket = fim.id_ticket
        ) t_base
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(t_base.start_ts::date, t_base.end_ts::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
        WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.day) < 6
          AND t_base.start_ts IS NOT NULL 
          AND t_base.end_ts IS NOT NULL
          AND LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) > GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
        GROUP BY t_base.id_ticket
    ) as primeiro_retorno
    ON primeiro_retorno.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: TEMPO PARA N3 UTILIZANDO A LÓGICA DO V360 (task_duration_min / 60)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_tasks.id_ticket,
            SUM(t_tasks.task_duration_min) / 60.0 AS tempo_para_n3
        FROM cs_operations_help360 t_tasks
        INNER JOIN (
            -- Descobre quando o chamado entrou na fila de N3 pela primeira vez
            SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS n3_start_ts
            FROM cs_operations_help360
            WHERE name_task IN ('Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração', 'Aguardando Desenvolvimento de Integração')
            GROUP BY id_ticket
        ) n3_entry ON t_tasks.id_ticket = n3_entry.id_ticket
        -- Soma o tempo (onde tem SLA) de todas as tarefas ANTERIORES à entrada em N3
        WHERE t_tasks.count_to_sla = true 
          AND t_tasks.created_at < n3_entry.n3_start_ts
        GROUP BY t_tasks.id_ticket
    ) as n3_time
    ON n3_time.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
    WHERE 
        t.id_ticket NOT IN (SELECT id_ticket FROM cs_operations_help360 WHERE completed_at IS NULL)  and  t.process_completion_type <> 'CANCELED' and t.client_name <> 'v360-interno' 
    GROUP BY 
        t.id_ticket,
        t.payed_by_customer,
        reclassificacao.teve_transformar, 
        n2_info.atuacao_n2,
        n2_info.tempo_atuacao_n2,
        primeiro_retorno.tempo_de_primeiro_retorno,

        t.cf_atendente_dev,
        t.cf_atendente_suporte,
        t.fluxo,
        t.cf_categoria_novo,
        t.cf_area_problema,
        t.cf_ajuda_funcional_dev,
        t.cf_funcional_ou_dev_que_ajudou,
        t.cf_complexidade_da_ajuda,
        t.cf_erp_cliente,
        t.cf_classificacao_chamados
      
) g

GROUP BY

    LEFT JOIN (

            t_base.id_ticket,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                    LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) 
                    - 
                    GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
                )) / 3600.0
            ) AS tempo_de_primeiro_retorno
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                inicio.id_ticket,
                inicio.start_ts,
                fim.end_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS start_ts
                FROM cs_operations_help360
                WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) inicio
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(completed_at) AS end_ts
                FROM (
                    SELECT 
                        id_ticket, 
                        name_task, 
                        completed_at,
                        LEAD(name_task) OVER (PARTITION BY id_ticket ORDER BY created_at) as next_task
                    FROM cs_operations_help360

                  AND (next_task NOT IN ('Transformar em Chamado de Suporte', 'Transformar em Chamado de Bug ', 'Executar - Preencher SLA') OR next_task IS NULL)
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) fim ON inicio.id_ticket = fim.id_ticket
        ) t_base
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(t_base.start_ts::date, t_base.end_ts::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
        WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.day) < 6
          AND t_base.start_ts IS NOT NULL 
          AND t_base.end_ts IS NOT NULL
          AND LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) > GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
        GROUP BY t_base.id_ticket
    ) as primeiro_retorno
    ON primeiro_retorno.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: TEMPO PARA N3 UTILIZANDO A LÓGICA DO V360 (task_duration_min / 60)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_tasks.id_ticket,
            SUM(t_tasks.task_duration_min) / 60.0 AS tempo_para_n3

        INNER JOIN (

            FROM cs_operations_help360
            WHERE name_task IN ('Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração', 'Aguardando Desenvolvimento de Integração')
            GROUP BY id_ticket
        ) n3_entry ON t_tasks.id_ticket = n3_entry.id_ticket
        -- Soma o tempo (onde tem SLA) de todas as tarefas ANTERIORES à entrada em N3
        WHERE t_tasks.count_to_sla = true 
          AND t_tasks.created_at < n3_entry.n3_start_ts
        GROUP BY t_tasks.id_ticket
    ) as n3_time
    ON n3_time.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE count_to_sla = true 
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as tempo_v360
    ON tempo_v360.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
                  when count_to_sla = FALSE then TRUE
                  else FALSE
                   end AS fechado_por_inatividade
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Executar - Comentar na nota encerrando o chamado'
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        fechado_por_inatividade
    ) as concluido_inativo
    ON concluido_inativo.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
                  when count_to_sla = FALSE then TRUE
                  else FALSE
                   end AS ticket_refused
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Recusado'
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        ticket_refused
    ) as chamado_recusado
    ON chamado_recusado.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
    
    
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
                  when count_to_sla = FALSE then TRUE
                  else FALSE
                   end AS bug_to_suport
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Transformar em Chamado de Suporte' 
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        bug_to_suport
    ) as bug_to_suporte
    ON bug_to_suporte.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
     LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               CASE 
               when count_to_sla = FALSE then true
               else false end as complementary_info
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Informações Complementares - PRD' 
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        complementary_info
    ) as info_complementares
    ON info_complementares.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               count_to_sla as parceiro_integracao
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração - Parceiro de Integração' 
        GROUP BY id_ticket, 
        parceiro_integracao
    ) as parceiro_integracao_b
    ON parceiro_integracao_b.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: IDENTIFICA SE O CHAMADO PASSOU POR ALGUMA TAREFA DE TRANSFORMAR
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT id_ticket,
               true AS teve_transformar
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE name_task ILIKE '%transformar%'
        GROUP BY id_ticket
    ) as reclassificacao
    ON reclassificacao.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- NOVA SUBQUERY: INFO DE ATUAÇÃO N2 (TAREFA 534)
    LEFT JOIN (
SELECT id_ticket,
               true AS atuacao_n2,
               SUM(task_duration_min) AS tempo_atuacao_n2
        FROM cs_operations_help360
        WHERE id_task_definition in ('494','496')  
        group by id_ticket
        having sum(task_duration_min) > 1
    ) as n2_info
    ON n2_info.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY PARA O TEMPO DE PRIMEIRO RETORNO (IGNORANDO RECALCULAR SLA)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_base.id_ticket,
            SUM(
                EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
                    LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) 
                    - 
                    GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
                )) / 3600.0
            ) AS tempo_de_primeiro_retorno
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                inicio.id_ticket,
                inicio.start_ts,
                fim.end_ts
            FROM (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS start_ts
                FROM cs_operations_help360
                WHERE name_task = 'Aguardar - Primeiro Atendimento'
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) inicio
            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT id_ticket, MIN(completed_at) AS end_ts
                FROM (
                    SELECT 
                        id_ticket, 
                        name_task, 
                        completed_at,
                        LEAD(name_task) OVER (PARTITION BY id_ticket ORDER BY created_at) as next_task
                    FROM cs_operations_help360
                ) sequencia
                WHERE name_task = 'Chamado Em Análise'
                  AND (next_task NOT IN ('Transformar em Chamado de Suporte', 'Transformar em Chamado de Bug ', 'Executar - Preencher SLA') OR next_task IS NULL)
                GROUP BY id_ticket
            ) fim ON inicio.id_ticket = fim.id_ticket
        ) t_base
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(t_base.start_ts::date, t_base.end_ts::date, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
        WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM d.day) < 6
          AND t_base.start_ts IS NOT NULL 
          AND t_base.end_ts IS NOT NULL
          AND LEAST(d.day::timestamp + interval '18 hours', t_base.end_ts) > GREATEST(d.day::timestamp + interval '9 hours', t_base.start_ts)
        GROUP BY t_base.id_ticket
    ) as primeiro_retorno
    ON primeiro_retorno.id_ticket = t.id_ticket

    -- SUBQUERY: TEMPO PARA N3 UTILIZANDO A LÓGICA DO V360 (task_duration_min / 60)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            t_tasks.id_ticket,
            SUM(t_tasks.task_duration_min) / 60.0 AS tempo_para_n3
        FROM cs_operations_help360 t_tasks
        INNER JOIN (
            -- Descobre quando o chamado entrou na fila de N3 pela primeira vez
            SELECT id_ticket, MIN(created_at) AS n3_start_ts
            FROM cs_operations_help360
            WHERE name_task IN ('Aguardar - Desenvolvimento Integração', 'Aguardando Desenvolvimento de Integração')
            GROUP BY id_ticket
        ) n3_entry ON t_tasks.id_ticket = n3_entry.id_ticket
        -- Soma o tempo (onde tem SLA) de todas as tarefas ANTERIORES à entrada em N3
        WHERE t_tasks.count_to_sla = true 
          AND t_tasks.created_at < n3_entry.n3_start_ts
        GROUP BY t_tasks.id_ticket
    ) as n3_time
    ON n3_time.id_ticket = t.id_ticket
  
  
    WHERE 
        t.id_ticket NOT IN (SELECT id_ticket FROM cs_operations_help360 WHERE completed_at IS NULL)  and  t.process_completion_type <> 'CANCELED' and t.client_name <> 'v360-interno' 
    GROUP BY 
        t.id_ticket,
        t.payed_by_customer,
        reclassificacao.teve_transformar, 
        n2_info.atuacao_n2,
        n2_info.tempo_atuacao_n2,
        primeiro_retorno.tempo_de_primeiro_retorno,
        n3_time.tempo_para_n3, 
        first_answer.tempo_de_resposta_inicial,
        tempo_v360.hours_v360,
        dev_integracao.tempo_de_integracao,
        chamado_em_analise.tempo_de_analise,
        concluido_inativo.fechado_por_inatividade,
        chamado_recusado.ticket_refused,
        info_complementares.complementary_info,
        bug_to_suporte.bug_to_suport,
        parceiro_integracao_b.parceiro_integracao,
        t.contracted_plan,
        t.cf_atendente_dev,
        t.cf_atendente_suporte,
        t.fluxo,
        t.cf_categoria_novo,
        t.cf_area_problema,
        t.cf_ajuda_funcional_dev,
        t.cf_funcional_ou_dev_que_ajudou,
        t.cf_complexidade_da_ajuda,
        t.cf_erp_cliente,
        t.cf_classificacao_chamados
      
) g

GROUP BY 
    id_ticket,
    client_name,
    resposta_csat,
    payed_by_customer,
    ticket_duration_days,
    business_hours_spent,
    first_at_ticket,
    g.atuacao_n2, -- AGRUPAMENTO AQUI
    g.tempo_atuacao_n2, -- AGRUPAMENTO AQUI
    g.chamados_nao_reclassificados, 
    g.tempo_para_n3, 
    g.tempo_de_primeiro_retorno,
    g.tempo_de_resposta_inicial,
    g.hours_v360,
    g.tempo_de_integracao,
    g.tempo_de_analise,
    g.fechado_por_inatividade,
    g.ticket_refused,
    g.complementary_info,
    g.bug_to_suport,
    g.chamado_pos_tombamento,
    g.parceiro_integracao,
    priority_ticket,
    label_category,
    responsible_team,
    github_link,
    ticket_title,
    due_date,
    sla_month,
    process_completion_type,
    category_ticket,
    csat_motivo,
    csat_comment,
    contracted_plan,
    cf_atendente_dev,
    cf_atendente_suporte,
    fluxo,
    cf_categoria_novo,
    cf_area_problema,
    cf_ajuda_funcional_dev,
    cf_funcional_ou_dev_que_ajudou,
    cf_complexidade_da_ajuda,
    cf_erp_cliente,
    cf_classificacao_chamados
) AS src
 WHERE 1=1
   {{ filters }}
 GROUP BY "sla_month", concat_ws(' / ', (( CASE 
    WHEN label_category = 'Vhelper::SupportTicket' THEN 'Suporte'
    WHEN label_category = 'Vhelper::ImprovementTicket' THEN 'Melhoria'
    WHEN label_category = 'Vhelper::BugTicket' THEN 'Bug'
